name: MOZAMBIQUE

flag.title: Flag of Mozambique
flag.note: AK-47 on a flag — unique in the world

lead: Mozambique lies on Africa's south-east coast, where savanna and golden beaches meet the warm Indian Ocean. Portuguese traders came 500 years ago. Now piri-piri prawns, Makonde carvings and marrabenta music fill the country.

facts.label: Capital
facts.sub: City of acacias on the bay

geo: Mozambique's coast runs 2,470 km along the Indian Ocean. Coral reefs, mangroves and palm-fringed islands line it. Great rivers like the Zambezi cross the country to the sea.
Inland, flat plains rise to plateaus and the Chimanimani Mountains. Monte Binga, 2,436 m high, stands on the Zimbabwe border.
animals: Bazaruto Archipelago has East Africa's last healthy dugongs. These sea-cow relatives graze on seagrass. Whale sharks and manta rays visit from October to April. Five kinds of turtle nest on the beaches.
Gorongosa National Park almost lost its animals. A 2024 count found 110,000 large animals, including lions, elephants and hippos.
culture: Mozambican food mixes many flavours. Piri-piri chilli spices up prawns and chicken. Cassava and coconut-milk stews come from Bantu roots. Arab flatbreads appear in the north.
Marrabenta music began in the 1950s on guitars made from oil cans and fishing wire. Its bouncy beat is made for dancing. The Chopi people play timbila xylophone orchestras, which UNESCO honours.
history: Arab traders reached the coast around 800 CE and built Swahili city-states. Vasco da Gama arrived in 1498. Portugal ruled from the tiny Island of Mozambique, now a UNESCO World Heritage site.
A ten-year war ended in 1975, when FRELIMO won freedom. A sixteen-year civil war then killed over a million people. Peace came in 1992.
wows: Mozambique is the only country name with all five vowels.
Its flag is the only one on Earth with an AK-47 rifle.
A Portuguese chapel built here in 1522 is the oldest European building in the southern hemisphere.
Mozambique has over 750 bird species, about 50 more than all of Europe.
Bazaruto has 250 to 350 dugongs, Africa's last big colony on the east coast.
In Scrabble, Mozambique scores 34 points, the most of any one-word country.
Gorongosa went from almost no large animals to 110,000 by 2024.

myths.fact: They are fish, not mammals. They are also the biggest fish in the sea.

myths.myth: A turtle can climb out of its shell
myths.fact: The shell is part of the turtle's body. Its ribs and backbone are joined to it.
